CustomField.description: Older storage for option scores, read only while Picklist Option Settings is empty. Forms saved before Picklist Option Settings existed keep their scores here; the option windows now save scores to Picklist Option Settings instead. Stored as JSON mapping each API value to a number. A score becomes the answer's Number Value in Form Submission Answer records; the form never shows it.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Older option scores, used only until the field's option settings are saved from Form Builder.
CustomField.label: Picklist Option Scores
